reviews.review: The aliens come out of now where. There is not an actual path that they don't take. Walls, ceiling, floor, it doesn't matter. There is not a pattern either! Best keep you on you toes style game I gave played in a long time! This game was a gift to me.

Love on first sight but it's dead.

Game itself is pretty fun if you like aliens and all that, however devs pretty much abandoned it after the first DLC.

I like it, but it takes FOREVER to queue up for any mission with anyone (intense difficulty mind you!). And I'm not playing in the middle of the night, or in the middle of nowhere. When you can't find groups for hours in central europe in middle of saturday, the game is dead.

Also devs patched like no bugs since release. You can get glitched inside things, you can get kicked at the start of the game, when entering new areas the entire game lags like hell because it's loading some bs or whatever (my pc can run ARK survival evolved on ultra with no issues mind you!), and the list goes on.

Overall the marines vs aliens experience itself is not bad, but it feels unfinished for some reason. I really would like to know what happens next. There's like a lot of things going on that eventualy lead to absolutely nothing. Also the last mission of the main campaign is a joke.

If your friends don't have this game, don't buy it. Not even crossplay enabled got me queued up for anything today. It's crazy.

Boring third person shooter Left 4 Dead in Alien franchise. I tried it later with friends and it got a tad bit more enjoyable. But still... maybe fans of Alien would appreciate this game better.

Verdict
☐ STAY AWAY FROM THIS!
☐ I would not recommend this
☑ You may get this on sale :)
☐ I would recommend this
☐ PLAY THIS BEFORE U DIE!

It is a solid l4d style atmospheric squad shooter with straight up surprisingly robust rpg chops.  Thank God they didn't create yet another ♥♥♥♥ Aliens game, this one returned my faith in the franchise.
